reconstruction.method: Registered grid centers pooled across three emissions; fourfold consensus rejects passing star sprites. Two binary alpha layers retain independent observed core and rim colors. Screen-wide illumination remains a separate additive plane.
reconstruction.limitations: The compressed glow makes subcell edge width uncertain; a 5/6 fill ratio approximates the measured 0.81-0.85 occupancy. Hidden portions share the visible rotational symmetry.
